claims: Brooks Rosser is a 22-year-old singer from Bel Air, Maryland.
Brooks Rosser is a dementia care medication technician.
Brooks Rosser is a contestant on American Idol Season 24.
Brooks Rosser earned a Platinum Ticket.
Brooks Rosser advanced to the Top 20.
Brooks Rosser had limited public performing experience prior to the show.
Brooks Rosser focused mainly on playing guitar prior to the show.
Lionel Richie, Carrie Underwood, and Luke Bryan were judges during Brooks Rosser's initial audition.
Brooks Rosser was named as part of the Top 20 following a performance in early March 2026.
Brooks Rosser performed Sam Barber's "Drowning" during Hollywood Week.
Brooks Rosser performed "Everywhere, Everything" by Noah Kahan.
There was a different contestant named Brooks Kidd who auditioned in American Idol Season 20.
American Idol has a 57-second YouTube video of Brooks Rosser's performance of "Everywhere, Everything" dated Mar 9, 2026.
